main.description: A nomination of one Bluesky account into skymash's head-to-head comparison pool. Nomination is open to any account — there is no eligibility bar to clear. One record per (nominator, subject) — the record key is the subject's DID, so re-nominating the same account just overwrites in place rather than creating a duplicate. Different nominators nominating the same subject each get their own record; the pool is the de-duplicated union across every nominator's repo, read back via listReposByCollection. Written and read by skymash (https://skymash.bisks.net).

subject.description: The nominated account's DID. Also this record's own rkey.

handle.description: The nominated account's handle, snapshotted at nomination time for display without an extra lookup.

score.description: The subject's mutual-follow pool size at nomination time — skymash's "cluster score", computed the same way as the sites/simcluster* family (mutuals, widened to follows if the mutual pool is too thin). Community positioning, not raw follower count. Informational only — the nomination form no longer requires a minimum score to write the record.

nominatedAt.description: When this nomination was written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
